evidence: Updates src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp, src/rpc/txoutproof.cpp, src/rpc/util.cpp, and src/rest.cpp to return structured error data for pruned lookups.
rationale: Adds structured error responses returning candidate pruned block hashes to getrawtransaction, gettxoutproof, and REST endpoints. This eliminates an integration gap by allowing downstream clients to fetch missing blocks on demand via getblockfrompeer.
